create_scheduler: create a FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler instance with custom num_train_timesteps and shift parameters
set_timesteps: set the discrete timesteps for the diffusion chain before running inference
step_denoising: step the scheduler to predict the sample from the previous timestep using model output
scale_noise: scale noise on a sample using the forward process in flow-matching
set_begin_index: set the begin index for the scheduler before starting the inference loop
